nodes.speaker: filthy_rich
nodes.text: I congratulate you on purchasing this bar.

nodes.speaker: player
nodes.text: Thank you very much! A dream is finally coming true!

nodes.speaker: filthy_rich
nodes.text: Don't forget that you have exactly 5 days to prove your profitability, otherwise I will be forced to close the bar.

nodes.speaker: filthy_rich
nodes.text: You must show profitability of at least two thousand bits, then you will prove the profitability of the bar. Quite a lifting amount, in my opinion.

nodes.speaker: player
nodes.text: Okay. I guess it won't be difficult.

nodes.speaker: filthy_rich
nodes.text: Try not to sell too much alcohol. And even more so, do not drink it in the workplace.

nodes.speaker: filthy_rich
nodes.text: Also, please don't turn on loud music in the middle of the night.

nodes.speaker: filthy_rich
nodes.text: Good luck in your new job.

nodes.speaker: filthy_rich
nodes.text: If you need money, you can find me in the town. I can provide you with special conditions on an interest-free basis.
